heroHeadline: Presidential adviser Cerimedo jailed 180 days over attempted femicide of ex-partner
heroSubtitle: A Santa Cruz judge orders Fernando Cerimedo, an Argentine consultant listed as Paz's "principal adviser," held at Palmasola after prosecutors cite phone messages tied to the Aug. 17 shooting of Nadia Beller, who alleges the attack followed her threat to expose corruption reaching the president's family; the government now denies he held any formal state role.
